name: Chợ Đầm
kicker: The market gate at Bến Chợ
summary: Chợ Đầm is the central market at Bến Chợ, Vạn Thạnh. The provincial page says entry is free. The lotus hall is 66.5 m across, 5,270 m², and sized for over 3,000 people. The market was built up in 1908 on a former lagoon of 7 ha. An opening hour was not printed. Inside, the page names seafood and the bowls bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem.
getThere: Bến Chợ, Vạn Thạnh. Minutes from the beach were not printed.
heroCaption: The Chợ Đầm gate, flags, and the street in front
body: The provincial page puts the market at Bến Chợ, Vạn Thạnh, and says it is free. It compares the hall to a lotus, with a diameter of 66.5 m, an area of 5,270 m², and room for over 3,000 people. The site was a lagoon of 7 ha. The market was built up in 1908. Hours are not printed.

The same page names the seafood counter: cá đuối, cá song, mực ống, mực nang, tôm, cua, and ghẹ, fresh, plus dried seafood. It also names bún cá, bún chả cá, and nem as food inside the market. A stall price was not printed.
